projects.purpose: Tracker my stock price and changes over a 5 day or ten day period

actions.lastAction: Increased text size on main page for easier viewing. Added a table for adding multple stocks and the ablity to delete a stock.
actions.todayAction: Added anoth stock to track - GCT & QUBT

actions.lastAction: Added anoth stock to track - GCT & QUBT
actions.todayAction: Fix error on number of days from last refresh. Change font on delete button to same size as refresh button.
actions.todayActionNotes:
Price movement alert (core)
Template:
AAPL moved +5.2% in 1 day. Now $192.34. Reply STOP to opt out.
Why: this matches your current threshold logic and is the main value.

Strong move alert (priority tier)
Template:
High move: TSLA jumped +10.4% in 2 days. Now $241.10.
Why: separates normal alerts from “pay attention now” alerts.

New high / new low (7-day window)
Template:
NVDA hit a new 7-day high: $118.90.
Template:
AMD hit a new 7-day low: $142.30.
Why: very easy to understand at a glance.

Daily summary (single digest instead of many pings)
Template:
Daily summary: 3 movers today. AAPL +2.1%, MSFT -1.4%, TSLA +4.7%.
Why: reduces notification fatigue.

Watchlist inactivity reminder
Template:
No price refresh for 24h on 4 symbols. Open MyTickerTracker to update.
Why: helps re-engagement without being spammy.

Added symbol confirmation
Template:
Tracking started: AMZN. Threshold alert set to 5%.
Why: confirms user action and setting.

Failed price fetch
Template:
Couldn’t update NFLX right now. We’ll retry automatically.
Why: turns silent failure into trust-building communication.

Test alert confirmation
Template:
Test alert sent successfully for AAPL.
Why: avoids confusion when users tap test.

Market open nudge (optional)
Template:
Market is open. 2 symbols are within 1% of your alert threshold.
Why: timely, actionable, and not noisy.

Quiet-hours deferred alert
Template:
Quiet hours active. 2 alerts queued and will be sent at 8:00 AM.
Why: respects user sleep and prevents churn.

Recommended guardrails for SMS:

Cap to 3-5 texts per symbol per day.
Send only on threshold crossing, not every poll while still above threshold.
Add a cooldown window (for example, 2-4 hours per symbol per alert type).
Always include symbol, percent change, timeframe, and current price.
Add opt-out language where required (STOP/HELP).
If you want, I can draft a compact notification rules matrix next (trigger, condition, cooldown, template) so you can plug it directly into your app logic.
